correctness.rationale: For positive C1 density f on circle and G(theta)=int_theta^(theta+pi) f, unique large circular gap in triple gives p(f)=3 int f G^2; exchangeability yields int fG=1/2 and Delta=3 int f(G-1/2)^2. Setting u=G-1/2 with u odd under antipodal shift and h=f-f_pi=-u prime, Fourier-Parseval gives ||u||2^2=8pi sum_{odd k}|fhat(k)|^2/k^2, yielding 24pi m/M spectral bounds. Integration by parts ||h||2^2 <=||u||2||h prime||2, with ||h||2^2>=2T^2/pi and ||h prime||2 <=2L sqrt(2pi), proves Delta>=3m T^4/(2pi^3 L^2). The bounded-slope f_k=(1+cos(k theta)/k)/(2pi) odd k>=3 gives T=2/(pi k) and Delta=3/(2pi^2 k^4), sharp exponent only (not prefactor). Independent midpoint integration for 4 odd k matches exact deficit. Positivity and C1 regularity are essential.
